In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: nintendo: fix out-of-bounds read in joycon_ctlr_read_handler()

joycon_ctlr_read_handler() casts an incoming HID input report to
struct joycon_input_report and parses it, guarding the cast only with a
12-byte length check:

	if (size >= 12) /* make sure it contains the input report */
		joycon_parse_report(ctlr, (struct joycon_input_report *)data);

struct joycon_input_report is 49 bytes: a 13-byte header followed by a
union whose IMU arm is 36 bytes. For an IMU report joycon_parse_report()
-> joycon_parse_imu_report() walks that union (struct offsets 13..48),
so a report of exactly 12 bytes with data[0] == JC_INPUT_IMU_DATA passes
the guard yet is read up to 37 bytes past its declared length. The
over-read bytes are decoded into accelerometer/gyroscope values and
forwarded to userspace through the "(IMU)" input device, leaking
driver-internal memory. data[0] and size are fully controlled by a
malicious or spoofed Joy-Con/Pro Controller.

Receive buffers are sized to the maximum report length, so this is an
over-read within the allocation rather than a slab OOB, but the decoded
bytes still reach userspace.

The sibling subcmd path in joycon_ctlr_handle_event() already bounds the
same cast correctly:

	if (size < sizeof(struct joycon_input_report) ||
	    data[0] != JC_INPUT_SUBCMD_REPLY)
		break;

Use the same sizeof(struct joycon_input_report) bound here.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: nintendo: register input device after capabilities are set

input_register_device() exposes the device to userspace immediately.
In joycon_input_create() it was called before joycon_config_rumble()
configures the FF_RUMBLE capability and the memless force-feedback
device, so a concurrent EVIOCSFF could dereference a NULL dev->ff.

Registering early also means the initial udev event lacks button and
axis information, which can make input managers ignore the device.

Move input_register_device() to the end of joycon_input_create(), after
all capabilities, the IMU input device and the force-feedback callbacks
have been configured.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: nintendo: stop device IO before hid_hw_stop on probe failure

nintendo_hid_probe() calls hid_device_io_start() before joycon_init()
and joycon_leds_create().  If either fails, the error path jumps to
err_close which calls hid_hw_close()/hid_hw_stop() without first calling
hid_device_io_stop().

hid_hw_stop() does not stop device IO, so hid_input_report() may still
run and access driver data that is being torn down, resulting in a
use-after-free.

Add an err_io_stop label that calls hid_device_io_stop() before
hid_hw_close(), and point the two post-io_start error paths at it.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: rapoo: fix missing hid_is_usb() check

to_usb_interface() can only be used on a hid_device whose parent is really
USB; uhid can create devices that identify as being on BUS_USB, but don't
actually have a USB parent.
Fix the use of to_usb_interface() without a hid_is_usb() check.

Add a dependency on USB_HID for hid_is_usb(), as other HID drivers do; the
alternative would be to provide a simple stub implementation on !USB_HID
builds.

I have verified that it is currently possible to trigger a kernel splat due
to this bug in an ASAN build, and that this commit fixes the issue.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: ft260: fix stack-use-after-return write in I2C read race

ft260_i2c_read() points dev->read_buf at a caller-supplied buffer
(often an on-stack variable), arms a completion and waits up to five
seconds for the device to return the data. The HID input callback
ft260_raw_event() runs in the input/IRQ path, independent of the
dev->lock mutex held by the read path, and copies the device-supplied
payload into dev->read_buf after a plain NULL check.

These two paths share read_buf, read_idx and read_len with no
serialization. If the device delays its response until the read
times out, ft260_i2c_read() resets the controller, clears read_buf
and returns, unwinding the stack frame the buffer lived in. A
response that arrives at that moment lets ft260_raw_event() pass the
NULL check and then memcpy() the device-controlled payload into the
now-freed stack location, a bounded but attacker-influenced
stack-use-after-return write triggerable by malicious or
malfunctioning hardware.

Add a dedicated spinlock that serializes every access to read_buf,
read_idx and read_len. ft260_raw_event() now holds it across the
NULL check, the memcpy and the index update, while the read path
takes it when arming and when clearing the buffer, so the teardown
can no longer slip between the check and the copy.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: sensor: custom: Fix use-after-free in enable_sensor

enable_sensor_store() can call set_power_report_state(), which
dereferences sensor_inst->power_state and sensor_inst->report_state.
These pointers refer to entries in sensor_inst->fields.

Create the field attributes before exposing the enable_sensor sysfs
attribute, so enable_sensor cannot be accessed before the state it
depends on has been initialized.

On remove, delete enable_sensor before freeing the field attributes,
so a concurrent sysfs write cannot dereference freed memory through
power_state or report_state.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: uclogic: fix use-after-free of inrange_timer on remove

uclogic_remove() cancels the pen in-range timer and then stops the
device:

	timer_delete_sync(&drvdata->inrange_timer);
	hid_hw_stop(hdev);

timer_delete_sync() only guarantees the timer is idle at that instant.
uclogic_raw_event_pen() keeps delivering pen reports until hid_hw_stop()
stops the transport several lines later, and every report with
pen->inrange == UCLOGIC_PARAMS_PEN_INRANGE_NONE re-arms the timer:

	mod_timer(&drvdata->inrange_timer, jiffies + msecs_to_jiffies(100));

A report landing between the timer_delete_sync() call and the transport
teardown in hid_hw_stop() re-arms inrange_timer after it was cancelled.
uclogic_remove() then returns and the devm drvdata is freed, while
hid_hw_stop() has already freed the input device drvdata->pen_input
points at, so when the timer fires ~100 ms later
uclogic_inrange_timeout() dereferences freed memory -- a use-after-free
in timer-softirq context.

Swapping the two calls is not a fix: stopping the device first frees
drvdata->pen_input via hidinput_disconnect() while the timer may still
be pending, so a timer already armed before removal fires on the freed
input device in the window before timer_delete_sync() runs.

Use timer_shutdown_sync() before hid_hw_stop() instead. It cancels the
timer, waits for a running callback while pen_input is still valid, and
prevents any further re-arming -- a later mod_timer() from an in-flight
report is silently ignored -- so the timer is provably dead before
hid_hw_stop() frees the inputs. This is the ordering the timer core
documents for this "timer re-armed from another path" teardown case.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

HID: hyperv: validate initial device info bounds

The Hyper-V synthetic HID host supplies SYNTH_HID_INITIAL_DEVICE_INFO
messages that contain a HID descriptor followed by the report descriptor
bytes. mousevsc_on_receive_device_info() trusts bLength and
wDescriptorLength without checking that the received packet contains both
byte ranges.

A malformed host or backend message can therefore make the guest read
past the received VMBus packet while copying the report descriptor. Pass
the received initial-device-info size into the parser and reject
descriptor lengths that exceed the packet.

Impact: A malicious Hyper-V host or backend can crash a guest by sending
a short initial device-info message with an oversized HID report
descriptor length.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: hci_event: fix LE list UAF on reset

hci_cc_reset() clears the LE accept and resolving lists without taking
hdev->lock. Other command-complete handlers serialize updates to these
lists with that lock, and the debugfs readers hold it while walking them.

This permits the reset completion and a debugfs read to interleave as
follows:

  hci_rx_work                 debugfs reader
  -----------                 --------------
                              lock hdev->lock
                              fetch current entry
  list_del(entry)
  kfree(entry)
                              read entry fields

The reader then dereferences a freed list entry and may follow its stale
next pointer.

KASAN reported:

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in white_list_show+0x15f/0x180
  Read of size 1 at addr ffff8881015dab16 by task poc/95

  Call Trace:
   white_list_show+0x15f/0x180
   seq_read_iter+0x3ff/0x1190
   seq_read+0x267/0x3d0
   vfs_read+0x177/0xa20
   ksys_read+0xf7/0x1c0

  Allocated by task 91:
   hci_bdaddr_list_add+0x1a6/0x3a0
   hci_cc_le_add_to_accept_list+0xab/0x140
   hci_cmd_complete_evt+0x26c/0x9a0
   hci_event_packet+0x454/0xb20
   hci_rx_work+0x293/0x730

  Freed by task 90:
   kfree+0x131/0x3c0
   hci_bdaddr_list_clear+0xd8/0x160
   hci_cc_reset+0x28a/0x370
   hci_cmd_complete_evt+0x26c/0x9a0
   hci_event_packet+0x454/0xb20
   hci_rx_work+0x293/0x730

Take hdev->lock around both list clears. This matches the existing
mutation and traversal locking convention.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: hci_event: validate LE Set CIG Parameters response

The Command Complete dispatch validates only the fixed part of the LE Set
CIG Parameters response. After that part is pulled from the skb,
hci_cc_le_set_cig_params() trusts num_handles and reads each entry in the
trailing handle array.

Matching num_handles against the command's num_cis does not guarantee
that the response contains the advertised handles. A truncated response
from a malfunctioning controller can therefore make the handler read
beyond the skb data.

Validate that the remaining skb data contains all advertised handles.
Include this in the existing response validation so malformed responses
also follow the established CIG failure handling.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: hci_sync: Fix accept list UAF during suspend

hci_update_event_filter_sync() walks hdev->accept_list while sending a
synchronous HCI command for each remote-wakeup device.  The suspend path
holds hdev->req_lock, but accept-list updates are serialized by hdev->lock.
Consequently, remove_device() can free the current list entry during the
controller wait.

The following interleaving causes the use-after-free:

  hci_update_event_filter_sync()    remove_device()
  fetch accept-list entry
  hci_set_event_filter_sync()
    wait for controller response    hci_dev_lock()
                                    list_del()
                                    kfree()
                                    hci_dev_unlock()
  read the freed list.next

KASAN reported:

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in hci_suspend_sync+0x835/0x910
  Read of size 8 at addr ffff88810bec8440 by task kworker/0:1/10
  Workqueue: events vhci_suspend_work
  Call Trace:
   hci_suspend_sync+0x835/0x910
   hci_suspend_dev+0x182/0x450
   process_one_work+0x661/0x1090
   worker_thread+0x45b/0xd10

  Allocated by task 86:
   hci_bdaddr_list_add_with_flags+0x1a8/0x400
   add_device+0x381/0x820
   hci_sock_sendmsg+0x1033/0x1ea0

  Freed by task 91:
   kfree+0x131/0x3c0
   remove_device+0x429/0xb70
   hci_sock_sendmsg+0x1033/0x1ea0

Snapshot the remote-wakeup addresses under hdev->lock.  Release the lock
before sending HCI commands.  Clear the controller event filter before
building the snapshot, and skip allocation and the second list traversal
when there are no matching entries.  This preserves the original filter
and scan-state updates without retaining an accept-list node across a
controller wait.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: ISO: zero the sockaddr before returning it in getname

iso_sock_getname() fills a struct sockaddr_iso in place and returns its
size without clearing it first, so bytes it does not write are copied to
user space from the kernel stack. The getsockname(2) and getpeername(2)
paths both run through do_getsockname(), which hands getname() an
uninitialized sockaddr_storage on the stack and copies back up to the
number of bytes getname() returns, so the driver has to initialize every
byte it accounts for.

Two ranges are left uninitialized:

  - struct sockaddr_iso is 10 bytes but only 9 are written (family,
    iso_bdaddr, iso_bdaddr_type), leaking the trailing pad byte on every
    call.

  - for a broadcast peer (BIS_LINK or PA_LINK) the returned length grows
    by sizeof(struct sockaddr_iso_bc), but only bc_sid, bc_num_bis and
    bc_bis are filled; bc_bdaddr and bc_bdaddr_type, the first 7 bytes of
    that structure, are never written.

An unprivileged process can open a BTPROTO_ISO socket and reach the pad
leak with getsockname(); the broadcast leak needs an established BIS/PA
connection. l2cap and rfcomm already memset their sockaddr in getname
for the same reason; do the same here.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

Bluetooth: hci_aml: validate firmware segment lengths

aml_download_firmware() reads two lengths from the firmware header and
uses them to build pointers before checking that the header and segment
data are present. A truncated or inconsistent firmware image can make
the driver read past firmware->data while constructing TCI commands.

Reject images shorter than the header and ensure that the ICCM and DCCM
ranges fit within the loaded firmware before downloading either segment.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

futex: Avoid private hash use-after-free on final put

futex_private_hash_put() drops the reference to fph before evaluating
fph->mm for wake_up_var(). futex_ref_put() enables preemption again before
returning. If that put drops the final reference and the task is preempted,
another task can pivot to the replacement hash and free the old hash after
an RCU grace period. The first task then reads fph->mm from the freed
allocation when it resumes.

KASAN reports a slab-use-after-free in futex_private_hash_put(), with the
read at offset 24 in a freed kmalloc-512 allocation. The allocation and
free stacks point to futex_hash_allocate() and the RCU free path,
respectively.

Load the mm pointer while the fph reference is still held and pass the
saved value to wake_up_var(). wake_up_var() uses the pointer as a waitqueue
key and does not dereference the mm through it.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ptp: vmclock: prevent read-only mappings from becoming writable

vmclock_miscdev_mmap() rejects writable mappings of the shared vmclock
ABI page with -EROFS, but leaves VM_MAYWRITE set.  Userspace can map the
page read-only and then upgrade it to writable with mprotect(), after
which the guest can corrupt the host-written timekeeping data (sequence
counter, UTC time, TSC offset) that the vmclock ABI defines as read-only.

Clear VM_MAYWRITE on the read-only path so the mapping cannot be
upgraded, as i915 does for its read-only objects and as fixed in drm/vc4
(CVE-2026-68445) and drm/panthor (CVE-2024-53071).

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

inet: frags: strip GSO state from fragments before reassembly

A virtio_net_hdr (tun/tap, or AF_PACKET with PACKET_VNET_HDR) can mark
an IPv4 or IPv6 fragment as GSO; nothing relates gso_type to frag_off.
inet_frag_reasm_prepare()/inet_frag_reasm_finish() keep the first
fragment's skb as the head of the reassembled datagram, including its
shinfo->gso_size/gso_type/gso_segs, and chain the remaining fragments
on frag_list with whatever linear/paged layout they arrived with.

After ip_defrag() (ip_local_deliver(), nf_defrag_ipv4, ...) the
reassembled skb therefore still claims to be GSO (SKB_GSO_DODGY), and
the next software segmentation point - udp_rcv_segment() on local
delivery, validate_xmit_skb(), or the ip_finish_output_gso() slow
path - hands it to skb_segment(). skb_segment()'s frag_list walk
assumes GRO-shaped input and hits one of its BUG_ON()s. Two writes to
a tap by an unprivileged user in its own userns are enough:

  kernel BUG at net/core/skbuff.c:4899!
  Oops: invalid opcode: 0000 [#1] SMP KASAN NOPTI
  CPU: 0 UID: 1000 PID: 82 Comm: poc Not tainted 7.2.0-pentest+ #2
  RIP: 0010:skb_segment+0x20ca/0x48b0
  Call Trace:
   <TASK>
   __udp_gso_segment+0x29a/0x27d0
   udp4_ufo_fragment+0x458/0x6c0
   inet_gso_segment+0x429/0x1340
   skb_mac_gso_segment+0x233/0x4f0
   __skb_gso_segment+0x308/0x660
   udp_queue_rcv_skb+0x440/0xad0
   udp_unicast_rcv_skb+0xc7/0x2c0
   udp_rcv+0x16ce/0x2260
   ip_protocol_deliver_rcu+0x197/0x2d0
   ip_local_deliver+0x430/0x690
   ip_rcv+0x16f/0x1f0
   __netif_receive_skb_one_core+0x15e/0x1c0
   __netif_receive_skb+0x1e/0x110
   netif_receive_skb+0xf6/0x5c0
   tun_rx_batched.isra.0+0x3ab/0x790
   tun_get_user+0x17c3/0x3550
   tun_chr_write_iter+0xba/0x1b0
   vfs_write+0x646/0x1130
   </TASK>
  Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt

This runs with BH disabled, so it is a panic rather than an oops. The
same is reachable with CAP_NET_RAW in a netns where a defrag point
precedes a GSO point, and from a guest whose VMM forwards
virtio_net_hdr to a tap. The SKB_GSO_DODGY frag_list checks added by
commit 3dcbdb134f32 ("net: gso: Fix skb_segment splat when splitting
gso_size mangled skb having linear-headed frag_list") and by
commit 9e4b7a99a03a ("net: gso: fix panic on frag_list with mixed head
alloc types") do not cover it: page-backed heads skip them, and kmalloc
heads skip them when gso_size == skb_headlen(head), which the sender
controls.

An skb entering a frag queue is an IP fragment by definition and
cannot legitimately carry GSO state: GRO does not merge fragments and
the stack segments before it fragments, so only untrusted sources are
affected. This has been reachable since
commit f43798c27684 ("tun: Allow GSO using virtio_net_hdr"), the first
path that let userspace attach GSO metadata to an IP fragment. Reset
the GSO fields of every fragment as it is queued, in
inet_frag_queue_insert(), which IPv4, IPv6, nf_conntrack_reasm and
6lowpan reassembly share; then neither the head nor the frag_list
members of the reassembled skb carry them (the members matter too:
the ip_do_fragment()/ip6_fragment() fast paths send them out as they
are). The head may remain CHECKSUM_PARTIAL; that is already accepted
on receive and resolved by skb_checksum_help() in
ip_do_fragment()/ip6_fragment() on forward.

Tested on top of net.git (dc4b95b8fee9), x86_64: the tap reproducer
above, two further IPv4 frag_list geometries that reach
BUG_ON(i >= nfrags) and BUG_ON(!list_skb->head_frag), and an IPv6
fragment-header variant (udp6_ufo_fragment()) each panic the unpatched
kernel; with this patch all four datagrams are delivered intact and
nothing is logged.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

usb: typec: ucsi: unregister debugfs entries on teardown

ucsi_register() creates per-instance debugfs entries, but
ucsi_unregister() keeps them around until ucsi_destroy().

Drivers like ucsi_glink that unregister/register the same UCSI
instance across remoteproc restart then try to create an already
existing debugfs directory and log:

  debugfs: 'pmic_glink.ucsi.0' already exists in 'ucsi'

Unregister debugfs entries as part of ucsi_unregister(), and
clear ucsi->debugfs after freeing it so repeated unregister
paths remain safe.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

wifi: iwlwifi: mei: pass correct argument to function

The first argument to iwl_mei_write_cyclic_buf() should be the cldev
but the q_head pointer is passed instead. Fix it.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/msm: Recover HW before retire hung submit

During recovery, it is not safe to retire the hung submit before we
recover the GPU. Retiring the submit triggers BO free and that can
result in GPU pagefaults since the GPU may be actively accessing those
BOs.

To fix this, retire the submits after gpu recovery is complete in
recover_worker().

Patchwork: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/730655/

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

staging: rtl8723bs: fix xmit_frame/xmit_buf leaks on mgnt-frame error paths

issue_beacon(), issue_probersp() and issue_asocrsp() obtain a management
xmit_frame together with its xmit_buf from the driver's fixed-size
management-TX pools via alloc_mgtxmitframe(). On the normal path the frame
is handed to dump_mgntframe(), which transfers ownership and eventually
returns both objects to their pools (the frame and, for beacons, the buf
in rtl8723bs_mgnt_xmit(); other bufs via the pending-xmitbuf/TX-completion
path).

Several error/edge paths return early after a successful
alloc_mgtxmitframe() but before dump_mgntframe(), so ownership is never
transferred and neither object is freed:

  - issue_beacon(): beacon larger than 512 bytes
  - issue_probersp(): cur_network->ie_length > MAX_IE_SZ
  - issue_probersp(): kzalloc() of the SSID scratch buffer fails
  - issue_asocrsp(): pkt_type is neither ASSOCRSP nor REASSOCRSP

Because alloc_mgtxmitframe() removes the frame and buf from their free
lists (list_del_init) without placing them on any pending list, an
orphaned pair is on no list and referenced by nobody, so it is only
reclaimed at driver teardown. Repeated hits progressively exhaust the
management-TX pools until alloc_mgtxmitframe() returns NULL and the
interface can no longer send beacons or probe/assoc responses.

Free the frame and buffer on these paths, matching the existing correct
error handling in issue_assocreq().

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

RDMA/srpt: Fix srpt_alloc_rw_ctxs() unwind counters

When srpt_alloc_rw_ctxs() fails partway through a multi-buffer indirect
descriptor, the unwind path destroys RDMA contexts but leaves stale
n_rw_ctx and n_rdma values (and a dangling rw_ctxs pointer). Later
sq_wr_avail accounting in srpt_queue_response() or srpt_write_pending()
can then subtract the wrong number of send queue credits.

Reset the counters and clear rw_ctxs after freeing the heap
allocation before returning an error.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

bpf: Mark bpf_refcount field as unique

BPF_REFCOUNT is not marked as a unique field, while it should be. Fix
this oversight.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ext4: fix transaction overflow during writeback

Commit 95ad8ee45cdb ("ext4: correct the reserved credits for extent
conversion") was correct to note that we need to reserve enough credits
for all extents possibly underlying a large folio. However it was too
eager to reduce the number of reserved credits. Extent conversion may
not only need to touch several leaf extent blocks, it may also need to
split extents - for example a single large unwritten extent may need to
be split into many small written ones in case of sparse folio dirtying.
This can thus result not only in extent leaf modifications but also in a
need to allocate new extent tree nodes. As a result the reserved
transaction credits were not sufficient in some corner cases. Use
ext4_meta_trans_blocks() for correct upper bound credit estimate.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ACPI: platform: Use acpi_bus_get_primary_device()

The acpi_get_first_physical_node() usage in acpi_platform_fill_resource()
and acpi_create_platform_device() is generally unsafe because in theory
the device returned by it may be freed at any time [1].

It is also inefficient because acpi_get_first_physical_node() is called
multiple times for the same argument which can be avoided.

Address these issues by using acpi_bus_get_primary_device() instead of
acpi_get_first_physical_node() and adjusting the code to call it just
once at the beginning of and acpi_create_platform_device() and drop
the device reference acquired by it upon the return from that function.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: hsr: free learned nodes on device setup failure

hsr_dev_finalize() can fail after a lower-device RX handler has
already been registered (slave A is added before the failable slave B
and interlink adds). RX handlers run in softirq regardless of the
master's state, so frames received in that window can learn dynamic
nodes into node_db, and the error unwind never releases them.

Free both owned dynamic databases in the unwind, mirroring
hsr_dellink(). proxy_node_db is provably empty on every current error
exit (only interlink RX feeds it, and the interlink add is the last
failable step) and is freed for symmetry. The order is safe:
hsr_del_port() unregisters each RX handler with synchronize_net()
before hsr_del_nodes() runs, which removes remaining entries with
list_del_rcu() and defers their release with call_rcu() for readers
already under RCU.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

netfilter: nf_nat_sip: rewind offset when NAT shrinks the packet

sashiko says:
 If map_addr() changes the packet length, such as when the public NAT IP
 string is shorter or longer than the internal IP, coff will still point to
 the offset relative to the pre-mangled packet.
 If the packet shrinks, coff could overshoot the correct position,
 potentially causing the next ct_sip_parse_header_uri() call to silently
 skip bytes and miss subsequent Contact headers. Could this lead to a
 failure to NAT those subsequent headers and leak internal network details?

An Improper Privilege Management vulnerability [CWE-269] vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.3, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiOS 7.2 all versions, FortiOS 7.0 all versions, FortiOS 6.4 all versions, FortiPAM 1.6.0, FortiPAM 1.5 all versions, FortiPAM 1.4 all versions, FortiPAM 1.3 all versions, FortiPAM 1.2 all versions, FortiPAM 1.1 all versions, FortiPAM 1.0 all versions may allow an authenticated administrator to bypass the trusted host policy via crafted CLI command.

VOCALOID6 Editor provided by Yamaha Corporation improperly restricts XML external entity references. Loading a specially crafted project file may the product to initiate unintended communication, potentially leading to the leak of sensitive information from the device where the product is installed or resulting in a denial-of-service (DoS) condition.

MobaXterm Personal Edition (Portable) 26.4 GA extracts the CygUtils64.plugin file without first verifying its integrity. A local attacker with write permissions on this file can replace the ‘bin/cygwin1.dll’ library contained within it with a malicious library. When the victim opens a Local Shell session or uses a Cygwin-based function, the application extracts the component and loads the tampered library, executing code with the victim’s permissions. Exploitation requires write access to the plugin and does not, in itself, involve privilege escalation.

A flaw has been found in SourceCodester Inventory System 1.0. This affects an unknown part of the file /api/products_handler.php?action=save of the component Product Management. Executing a manipulation of the argument Product_Id/Product_Name can lead to cross site scripting. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in YITH YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce yith-paypal-express-checkout-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects YITH PayPal Express Checkout for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.61.0.

Notes Station 3 3.9.12 and later

A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability has been reported to affect QuFTP Service. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to inject malicious code.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Codection Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce woo-products-restricted-users allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce: from n/a through 0.7.

A flaw has been found in Dav-ee dairy-management-system 31ace9692d1e1e6d64339a42c463b361319c615c/f31a584c3330c013b61f8b0306d9e0849c6d693d. Impacted is an unknown function of the file delivery/checkfarmer.json.php of the component AJAX Endpoint. This manipulation of the argument fname causes information disclosure. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Kirki: from n/a through 6.2.0.

A weakness has been identified in itsourcecode Online Cake Ordering System 1.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file confirm.php. This manipulation of the argument cancel causes sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

A flaw was found in bootc when operating with the default containers signature policy. Automatic or manual upgrades of a mutable image tag may apply unsigned content for registries that fall through to insecureAcceptAnything, allowing an attacker who can update that tag to execute arbitrary OS content as the host root filesystem on reboot.

A vulnerability was determined in hankcs HanLP up to 2.1.0-beta.64. This affects the function hanlp.load of the file plugins/hanlp_common/hanlp_common/reflection.py of the component Model Config Loading. This manipulation of the argument classpath causes deserialization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in Emacs TRAMP. A local attacker could exploit this vulnerability by processing maliciously crafted filenames. This occurs because TRAMP concatenates login arguments without proper sanitization, which are then passed to a local shell. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.

A flaw was found in rsyslog. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger a heap buffer overflow in the RainerScript `replace()` function by sending specially crafted syslog messages. This vulnerability arises from an incorrect buffer size calculation during string replacement, causing memory corruption. Successful exploitation can lead to a denial of service (DoS) for the affected system.

cves.d: A vulnerability was detected in radareorg radare2 6.2.0/6.2.2. This issue affects the function r_core_cmd_str_pipe in the library libr/core/rtr_http.inc.c of the component HTTP Sandbox Policy Handler. Performing a manipulation results in protection mechanism failure. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is assessed as difficult. Upgrading to version 6.2.4 is capable of addressing this issue. The patch is named 18fd12efa98a7d1977de7bdd379d8a848777b90f. Upgrading the affected component is recommended. The pre-requisite of the vulnerability is reflected by the CVSS vector. One of the project maintainers explains: "There is a real sandbox configuration issue here, but the report overstates it. The HTTP server defaults to http.sandbox=true, so commands received through /cmd temporarily enable cfg.sandbox. However, cfg.sandbox.grain defaults to all, which means all sandbox capabilities - including exec - remain allowed. Therefore enabling the HTTP sandbox alone does NOT prevent commands from spawning processes. This only matters when the HTTP command endpoint is reachable by someone you do not trust. It is not a remote vulnerability by default: the HTTP server must first be started and exposed to the attacker."

A flaw was found in libsoup. When constructing a masked WebSocket client frame for a very large outgoing payload, size values passed to GByteArray allocation APIs could be truncated while the masking routine still used the full length, causing a heap buffer overflow.

A flaw was found in libsoup. When reassembling fragmented WebSocket messages into a GByteArray, libsoup did not adequately cap total message size against the limits of the underlying buffer type. A remote peer could send fragments that caused size truncation while the implementation still used the full length, leading to heap corruption or a crash.

A flaw was found in libsoup. When handling an incoming WebSocket Pong frame, SoupWebsocketConnection emitted the ::pong signal with a GByteArray pointer even though the signal is declared to pass a GBytes. Applications connecting a handler that follows the documented GBytes API can trigger heap corruption or a crash upon receiving a crafted Pong.

A flaw was found in libsoup. When max-incoming-payload-size is unlimited (0), SoupWebsocketConnection could grow its incoming GByteArray based on an attacker-controlled frame length until the length wrapped, causing a heap buffer overflow while reading frame data.

A flaw was found in cockpit-files. A local unprivileged attacker can exploit a race condition during directory creation with owner assignment. By controlling a writable parent directory, the attacker can replace a newly created directory with a symbolic link (symlink) before the ownership change operation (chown) is applied. This allows the attacker to redirect the ownership change to an arbitrary file, potentially leading to information disclosure or unauthorized modification of sensitive files.

A flaw was found in cockpit-files. A low-privileged local user can exploit this vulnerability by crafting a directory containing a symbolic link (symlink) and then using the privileged "Paste as owner" function. This allows for arbitrary file ownership changes outside the intended pasted directory, leading to a compromise of data integrity. In some cases, this could also lead to reduced confidentiality if the new ownership grants unauthorized read access. Exploitation requires user interaction to select a non-original owner during the paste operation.

A vulnerability was identified in Tencent ncnn up to 44b02dabdcf97499281a4692ebd65bad73dcf8b6. Affected by this vulnerability is the function matmul_transb of the file src/layer/matmul.cpp of the component MatMul. The manipulation leads to out-of-bounds read. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A flaw was found in environment-modules. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by placing a maliciously named modulefile in a location visible to the victim's `MODULEPATH`. When the victim uses Bash completion for `module` or `ml` commands, the malicious module name, containing shell metacharacters, is evaluated as a command. This can lead to arbitrary command execution in the completing user's shell, impacting their confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

A security flaw has been discovered in diem-project diem up to 116974edfb9a5b8bd69cb13586dc62bcdbb485ad. This issue affects the function dmBaseLinkTag::text of the file dmCorePlugin/lib/view/html/link/dmBaseLinkTag.php of the component dmWidget. Performing a manipulation of the argument text results in cross site scripting. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A path traversal vulnerability has been reported to affect QcalAgent. If a remote attacker gains a user account, they can then exploit the vulnerability to read the contents of unexpected files or system data.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following version:
QcalAgent 1.1.10 and later

A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability has been reported to affect several QNAP operating system versions. The remote attackers can then exploit the vulnerability to bypass security mechanisms or read application data.

We have already fixed the vulnerability in the following versions:
QTS 5.2.9.3492 build 20260507 and later
QuTS hero h5.2.9.3499 build 20260514 and later
QuTS hero h5.3.4.3500 build 20260520 and later
QuTS hero h6.0.0.3500 build 20260520 and later

A vulnerability has been found in diem-project diem up to 116974edfb9a5b8bd69cb13586dc62bcdbb485ad. Affected by this vulnerability is the function html of the file dmAdminPlugin/web/js/dmAdminCtrl.js of the component Version Check Service. The manipulation leads to cross site scripting. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product follows a rolling release approach for continuous delivery, so version details for affected or updated releases are not provided. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
A vulnerability is in Web Server default connection ports under the process name GeoWebServer.exe .

ai.summary_en: Today's vulnerability landscape is dominated by critical flaws in enterprise infrastructure, particularly within the Microsoft ecosystem encompassing Windows operating systems, Azure cloud services, and the .NET framework. High-severity issues facilitate unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation across essential network services like DNS, DHCP, and Active Directory Federation Services, while also compromising web applications via ASP.NET Core and SQL Server. Significant risks extend to industrial control systems, IoT gateways, and developer toolchains, characterized by widespread buffer overflows, authentication bypasses, and attacks targeting AI workflows and image processing libraries.
ai.summary_zh: 当前的漏洞态势主要受企业基础设施关键缺陷主导，尤其是涵盖 Windows 操作系统、Azure 云服务及 .NET 框架的微软生态系统。高危漏洞使得攻击者能够在 DNS、DHCP 及 Active Directory 联合服务等关键网络服务中实现无需认证的远程代码执行与权限提升，同时通过 ASP.NET Core 和 SQL Server 危及 Web 应用。重大风险已蔓延至工业控制系统、IoT 网关及开发者工具链，主要表现为广泛的缓冲区溢出、身份验证绕过，以及针对 AI 工作流和图像处理库的攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9.8 heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables remote code execution without user interaction. This flaw is highly critical because Error Reporting runs by default on all Windows endpoints, significantly expanding the attack surface for full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 9.8 的 Windows Error Reporting 基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现远程代码执行。该缺陷极为严重，因为 Error Reporting 默认在所有 Windows 终端上运行，显著扩大了导致系统完全被控的攻击面。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 untrusted pointer dereference in Windows Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) Enclave allows local privilege escalation. Exploitation directly undermines hardware-enforced memory isolation, granting attackers access to protected credentials and kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 的 Windows Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) Enclave 不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致本地权限提升。利用该漏洞会直接破坏硬件强制执行的内存隔离机制，使攻击者能够访问受保护的凭据和内核内存。

items.reason_en: Windows Shell command injection is already listed in CISA KEV, indicating active exploitation in the wild. It allows unauthorized attackers to bypass security features over the network, posing an immediate threat to endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 命令注入漏洞已列入 CISA KEV，表明野外存在活跃利用。该漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络绕过安全功能，对终端完整性构成直接威胁。

items.reason_en: A critical use-after-free flaw in Windows OLE enables remote code execution via crafted objects. Its high CVSS score and widespread presence make it a prime target for drive-by and document-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows OLE 中的关键性释放后使用缺陷可通过构造对象实现远程代码执行。其高 CVSS 评分和广泛存在使其成为驱动下载和基于文档攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in BitLocker allows remote code execution, directly undermining data-at-rest encryption safeguards. Compromise of this component could expose encrypted volumes or facilitate lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: BitLocker 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许远程代码执行，直接破坏了静态数据加密防护。该组件被攻破可能导致加密卷暴露或促进横向移动。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Microsoft Office Excel enables network-based remote code execution. Given Excel's ubiquity in corporate environments, this vulnerability remains a primary vector for spear-phishing and macro-less malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现基于网络的远程代码执行。鉴于 Excel 在企业环境中的普及性，该漏洞仍是鱼叉式网络钓鱼和无宏恶意软件投递的主要途径。

items.reason_en: PowerShell's reliance on untrusted inputs permits remote code execution, severely impacting administrative automation. Attackers can leverage this to execute arbitrary commands in privileged contexts without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 依赖不受信任的输入可导致远程代码执行，严重影响管理自动化。攻击者可借此在特权上下文中无需用户交互即可执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Virtualization-Based Security Enclave allows local privilege escalation. This undermines hardware-enforced isolation mechanisms and could lead to full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Virtualization-Based Security Enclave 中的整数溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升。这会破坏硬件强制执行的隔离机制，并可能导致系统完全被控。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Raw Image Extension enables remote code execution through standard image parsing routines. Shared or downloaded images can trigger this flaw, making it highly exploitable across consumer and enterprise workstations.
items.reason_zh: Raw Image Extension 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过标准图像解析例程实现远程代码执行。共享或下载的图像可能触发此缺陷，使其在消费级和企业工作站中极易被利用。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Outlook enables network RCE via malicious emails, directly impacting a ubiquitous enterprise client.
items.reason_zh: Outlook 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意电子邮件实现网络远程代码执行，直接影响一款普及的企业客户端。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the PostScript printer driver allows network RCE through widely deployed printing subsystems, offering a high-value attack surface.
items.reason_zh: PostScript 打印机驱动程序中的堆溢出漏洞可通过广泛部署的打印子系统实现网络远程代码执行，提供了高价值攻击面。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Windows Kernel permits network-based privilege escalation, compromising core OS stability and security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Kernel 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可允许基于网络的权限提升，破坏核心操作系统稳定性和安全边界。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the BITS service enables network RCE, affecting background synchronization and update mechanisms across Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: BITS 服务中的释放后使用漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行，影响 Windows 终端上的后台同步和更新机制。

items.reason_en: Critical heap overflow in the MS XML parser allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious documents or files.
items.reason_zh: MS XML 解析器中的关键堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意文档或文件实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Severe out-of-bounds write in the RPC Runtime enables unauthenticated network-based code execution without requiring user interaction.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的严重越界写入漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现未认证的网络代码执行。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Windows Text Shaping allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely through crafted text rendering operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows Text Shaping 中的高危堆溢出漏洞允许攻击者通过构造文本渲染操作远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the SMB Client permits unauthenticated remote privilege escalation over the network, directly impacting file sharing infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: SMB Client 中的堆溢出漏洞可允许通过网络进行未认证的远程权限提升，直接影响文件共享基础设施。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the DNS Server allows remote attackers to execute code by exploiting malformed DNS responses.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞允许远程攻击者通过利用格式错误的 DNS 响应来执行代码。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Internet Messaging API enables remote code execution via malicious email attachments or message payloads.
items.reason_zh: Internet Messaging API 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意电子邮件附件或消息载荷实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Camera Frame Server Monitor allows adjacent network attackers to escalate privileges by targeting video capture streams.
items.reason_zh: Camera Frame Server Monitor 中的释放后使用漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者通过针对视频捕获流来提升权限。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows Event Tracing allows unauthenticated remote code execution by exploiting underlying event logging mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Event Tracing 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过利用底层事件日志记录机制实现未认证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Search Component enables remote code execution through the processing of indexed content.
items.reason_zh: Windows Search Component 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过处理索引内容实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in GDI+ allows remote attackers to execute code by rendering malicious graphics or image files.
items.reason_zh: GDI+ 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过渲染恶意图形或图像文件来执行代码。

items.reason_en: Critical heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables unauthorized remote code execution, posing a severe threat to endpoint security.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting 中的关键基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未授权的远程代码执行，对终端安全构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: High-severity heap overflow in Windows Media Foundation allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malicious media files.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的高危堆溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者通过恶意媒体文件执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in the Remote Desktop Client permits remote code execution, directly impacting secure administrative access.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的释放后使用缺陷可允许远程代码执行，直接影响安全的行政管理访问。

items.reason_en: Remote Desktop Services vulnerability allows unauthorized remote code execution, compromising critical remote management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Services 漏洞允许未授权的远程代码执行，破坏关键的远程管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Libarchive can be triggered by malicious archive files, leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Windows Libarchive 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可由恶意归档文件触发，从而导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables remote code execution without user interaction, significantly increasing the attack surface.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可在无需用户交互的情况下实现远程代码执行，显著扩大攻击面。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service directly enables credential dumping and full domain compromise.
items.reason_zh: Local Security Authority Subsystem Service 中的远程代码执行可直接实现凭据转储和完全控制整个域。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution via the PostScript printer driver allows immediate system takeover without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: 通过 PostScript 打印机驱动程序的未授权远程代码执行可在无需用户交互的情况下立即接管系统。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible integer overflow in a default Windows component enables arbitrary code execution upon routine image processing.
items.reason_zh: 默认 Windows 组件中可通过网络访问的整数溢出漏洞在常规图像处理时即可导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in the Hyper-V hypervisor breaks virtual machine isolation and threatens host stability.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 虚拟机管理程序中的本地权限提升会破坏虚拟机隔离性并威胁主机稳定性。

items.reason_en: Critical driver flaw enabling unauthenticated remote code execution, posing an immediate risk to Windows storage infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 关键驱动程序缺陷可导致未授权远程代码执行，对 Windows 存储基础设施构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Direct kernel memory corruption allows local privilege escalation, undermining core OS security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 内核内存直接损坏可导致本地权限提升，破坏核心操作系统安全边界。

items.reason_en: High-impact memory corruption in a widely used component enables remote code execution through common user interaction vectors.
items.reason_zh: 广泛使用组件中的高影响内存损坏漏洞可通过常见的用户交互向量实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Memory management flaw in the kernel facilitates local privilege escalation by corrupting critical system structures.
items.reason_zh: 内核中的内存管理缺陷通过损坏关键系统结构促成本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Media Foundation enables remote code execution via malicious media files, posing a direct threat to endpoint integrity.
items.reason_zh: Windows Media Foundation 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过恶意媒体文件实现远程代码执行，直接威胁终端完整性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the critical LSASS component allows remote code execution, significantly increasing the risk of credential dumping and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: 关键 LSASS 组件中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，显著增加凭据转储和横向移动的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Windows Imaging Component facilitates remote code execution through crafted image processing requests, affecting standard desktop workflows.
items.reason_zh: Windows Imaging Component 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过构造的图像处理请求实现远程代码执行，影响标准桌面工作流。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Win32k-GRFX driver provides a reliable local privilege escalation path commonly exploited in post-exploitation scenarios.
items.reason_zh: Win32k-GRFX 驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞提供了一条可靠的本地权限提升路径，常在利用后阶段被利用。

items.reason_en: Reliance on untrusted inputs in PowerShell enables remote code execution, compromising administrative automation and script-based deployments.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 依赖不受信任的输入可导致远程代码执行，破坏自动化管理任务和基于脚本的部署。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Shell allows unauthenticated network RCE, making it highly attractive for drive-by attacks and malicious file exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Shell 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，使其成为挂马攻击和恶意文件利用的高吸引力目标。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting enables unauthenticated network RCE, frequently leveraged by threat actors for initial access and lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows Error Reporting 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，常被威胁行为体用于初始访问和横向移动。

items.reason_en: Integer underflow in Windows PowerShell permits unauthenticated network RCE, exploiting a ubiquitous administrative tool to deploy payloads remotely.
items.reason_zh: Windows PowerShell 中的整数下溢漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，利用普及的管理工具远程投放有效载荷。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows GDI allows unauthenticated network RCE through processed images, commonly abused in phishing campaigns and malware delivery.
items.reason_zh: Windows GDI 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过处理的图像实现未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，常用于钓鱼活动和恶意软件投递。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables unauthenticated network RCE, directly compromising secure remote administration channels.
items.reason_zh: OpenSSH for Windows 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，直接破坏安全的远程管理通道。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Remote Desktop Client allows unauthenticated network RCE, targeting a critical remote access protocol used across enterprises.
items.reason_zh: 远程桌面客户端中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，针对企业广泛使用的关键远程访问协议。

items.reason_en: Code injection in Windows Encrypting File System permits unauthenticated network RCE, undermining data protection mechanisms and enabling remote system takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows 加密文件系统（EFS）中的代码注入漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，破坏数据保护机制并实现远程系统接管。

items.reason_en: Bypasses missing authentication in Credential Guard, enabling local spoofing attacks that undermine enterprise identity protection and secure boot mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 绕过 Credential Guard 的身份验证缺失问题，启用本地欺骗攻击，破坏企业身份保护和安全启动机制。

items.reason_en: Exploits a use-after-free flaw in LSASS, directly threatening credential theft and facilitating lateral movement within Active Directory environments.
items.reason_zh: 利用 LSASS 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞，直接威胁凭据窃取并在 Active Directory 环境中促进横向移动。

items.reason_en: Allows remote code execution via the Remote Desktop Client, posing a significant risk to administrators accessing systems over untrusted or public networks.
items.reason_zh: 通过远程桌面客户端允许远程代码执行，对通过不受信任或公共网络访问系统的管理员构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Leverages an untrusted search path in the Windows Update Service to enable DLL preloading and local privilege escalation during update processes.
items.reason_zh: 利用 Windows Update Service 中不受信任的搜索路径，在更新过程中启用 DLL 预加载和本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Libarchive enables remote code execution without authentication, posing a severe threat to all supported Windows platforms.
items.reason_zh: Windows Libarchive 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行，对所有受支持的 Windows 平台构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library allows attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely by processing malicious media files across numerous Windows versions.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library 中的整数溢出漏洞使攻击者能够通过处理恶意媒体文件在多个 Windows 版本上远程执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Windows Hyper-V permits authorized local attackers to escape isolation and execute code on the host system, compromising virtualized environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Hyper-V 中的访问控制不当允许已授权的本地攻击者突破隔离并在主机系统上执行代码，危及虚拟化环境。

items.reason_en: GIMP's PSD thumbnail loader contains a heap out-of-bounds read/write flaw triggered by crafted grayscale images, enabling crashes and potential adjacent heap data disclosure.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PSD 缩略图加载器存在由构造的灰度图像触发的堆越界读写缺陷，可导致崩溃及潜在的相邻堆数据泄露。

items.reason_en: FreeRDP suffers an integer underflow in the WinPR BMP writer that allows malicious RDP clipboard peers to trigger memory corruption via sub-byte image processing.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP 的 WinPR BMP 写入器存在整数下溢漏洞，允许恶意的 RDP 剪贴板对等节点通过亚字节图像处理触发内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Scheduler timeline pointer lifecycle flaw in the DRM/Xe driver can trigger a use-after-free, potentially allowing local privilege escalation on modern Linux workstations.
items.reason_zh: DRM/Xe 驱动程序中调度时间线指针生命周期缺陷可能触发释放后使用漏洞，潜在允许在现代 Linux 工作站上进行本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Context pstate handling issues in the AMDGPU driver introduce potential use-after-free and NULL pointer dereferences during initialization, risking system stability and graphical subsystem compromise.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU 驱动程序中的上下文 pstate 处理问题在初始化期间可能引入释放后使用和空指针解引用风险，危及系统稳定性和图形子系统安全。

items.reason_en: The ALSA timer subsystem lacks proper serialization for userspace-triggered interrupts, creating race conditions that could crash audio services or escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: ALSA定时器子系统缺乏针对用户空间触发中断的正确序列化机制，可能导致竞态条件，进而引发音频服务崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Wacom HID driver fails to halt hardware after probe errors, leaving input devices in an undefined state that could be exploited for input manipulation or denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Wacom HID驱动在探测错误后未能停止硬件运行，导致输入设备处于未定义状态，可能被利用进行输入操纵或拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Fixes a slab-out-of-bounds write in Wacom HID queue insertion, protecting against local privilege escalation via stylus input devices.
items.reason_zh: 修复Wacom HID队列插入过程中的slab越界写入漏洞，防止通过触控笔输入设备进行的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Bounds checks slot indexing in HID multitouch drivers, preventing out-of-bounds bit manipulation on modern touchscreen laptops.
items.reason_zh: 对HID多点触控驱动的槽位索引进行边界检查，防止在现代触摸屏笔记本电脑上发生越界位操作。

items.reason_en: Adds missing bounds validation in DRM EDID tiled block parsing, stopping potential kernel panics when interacting with malformed display monitors.
items.reason_zh: 在DRM EDID平铺块解析中补充缺失的边界验证，防止与畸形显示器交互时可能引发的内核恐慌。

items.reason_en: Validates control metadata from virtio-sound devices, ensuring untrusted audio backends cannot trigger host-side index-based exploits.
items.reason_zh: 验证来自virtio-sound设备的控制元数据，确保不受信任的音频后端无法触发主机端的基于索引的攻击。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in the AMD display driver allows local denial-of-service or potential code execution via malformed AUX transfers to the display controller.
items.reason_zh: AMD显示驱动中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过向显示控制器发送畸形AUX传输进行本地拒绝服务或潜在代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in AF_UNIX stream handling enables local privilege escalation or system crashes through crafted Unix socket operations without proper queue locking.
items.reason_zh: AF_UNIX流处理中的释放后使用漏洞，若缺乏正确的队列锁定，可通过构造Unix套接字操作实现本地权限提升或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: Prevents out-of-bounds writes in the Wacom HID driver by validating feature report field locations. Blocks local privilege escalation vectors via malicious USB/HID input devices commonly used on workstations.
items.reason_zh: 通过验证功能报告字段位置，防止Wacom HID驱动中的越界写入。阻断通过工作站常用的恶意USB/HID输入设备进行本地权限提升的攻击路径。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free bug in the Intel i915 GPU driver during TTM object purging operations. Mitigates potential graphical subsystem crashes or arbitrary code execution on affected desktop and laptop systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复Intel i915 GPU驱动在TTM对象清理操作期间的释放后使用漏洞。缓解受影响桌面和笔记本系统上图形子系统崩溃或任意代码执行的风险。

items.reason_en: Resolves a use-after-free vulnerability in the exfat filesystem directory entry lookup routine. Prevents local exploitation through crafted external storage media mounted on consumer operating systems.
items.reason_zh: 解决exfat文件系统目录项查找例程中的释放后使用漏洞。防止通过挂载到消费级操作系统上的构造外部存储介质进行本地利用。

items.reason_en: Fixes an infinite loop and out-of-bounds read in SMB client symlink handling, preventing potential denial-of-service or information disclosure on desktop file-sharing systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复SMB客户端符号链接处理中的无限循环和越界读取漏洞，防止桌面文件共享系统遭受潜在的拒绝服务或信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Addresses a security regression in the DRM GEM change_handle ioctl, mitigating risks related to unauthorized GPU context manipulation in desktop environments.
items.reason_zh: 解决DRM GEM change_handle ioctl的安全回归问题，缓解桌面环境中未经授权操纵GPU上下文的风险。

items.reason_en: Resolves a use-after-free flaw in the ALSA timer user parameters, protecting desktop audio applications from potential crashes or privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 解决ALSA定时器用户参数中的释放后使用缺陷，保护桌面音频应用免受潜在崩溃或权限提升的影响。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in Dell Application Store allows low-privileged local attackers to disclose sensitive information.
items.reason_zh: Dell Application Store中存在权限分配错误，允许低权限本地攻击者泄露敏感信息。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled path element vulnerability enables local privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution within the Dell Application Store environment.
items.reason_zh: Dell Application Store环境中的非受控路径元素漏洞可导致本地权限提升和任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in AMDGPU user queue management can lead to local denial-of-service or privilege escalation via compromised GPU drivers.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU用户队列管理中的释放后使用漏洞可能通过受损的GPU驱动程序导致本地拒绝服务或权限提升。

items.reason_en: Validates the entire DACL before rewriting ACLs in the SMB client, preventing unauthorized permission modifications on shared resources.
items.reason_zh: 在SMB客户端重写ACL前验证完整的DACL，防止共享资源遭受未经授权的权限修改。

items.reason_en: Fixes an out-of-bounds read in the Wacom HID Bluetooth driver when processing maliciously crafted short reports, mitigating kernel memory leaks.
items.reason_zh: 修复Wacom HID蓝牙驱动在处理恶意构造的短报告时的越界读取漏洞，缓解内核内存泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized VMA array in the Intel graphics driver may lead to undefined behavior or crashes during buffer execution, affecting desktop and laptop GPU stability.
items.reason_zh: Intel显卡驱动中未初始化的VMA数组可能在缓冲区执行期间导致未定义行为或崩溃，影响桌面和笔记本GPU的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's PVR plugin allows heap-based buffer overflow via crafted images, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution when users open malicious files.
items.reason_zh: GIMP的PVR插件存在整数溢出漏洞，可通过构造图像导致基于堆的缓冲区溢出，用户在打开恶意文件时可能引发任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Uncontrolled recursion in Qt's SVG parser causes stack exhaustion and application crashes when rendering deeply nested vector graphics, impacting desktop stability.
items.reason_zh: Qt的SVG解析器中存在非受控递归问题，渲染深度嵌套的矢量图形时会导致栈耗尽和应用崩溃，影响桌面稳定性。

items.reason_en: Allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted PDF files parsed by Autodesk Revit, posing a significant threat to engineering workstations.
items.reason_zh: 允许远程攻击者通过Autodesk Revit解析的构造PDF文件执行任意代码，对工程工作站构成重大威胁。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow during PSD thumbnail generation can lead to heap corruption and potential code execution when users open malicious image files.
items.reason_zh: 生成PSD缩略图时的整数溢出可能导致堆损坏，用户在打开恶意图像文件时可能引发代码执行。

items.reason_en: TOCTOU vulnerability in gvfs allows local attackers to escalate privileges by manipulating D-Bus socket ownership through symlink attacks.
items.reason_zh: gvfs中的TOCTOU漏洞允许本地攻击者通过符号链接攻击操纵D-Bus套接字所有权，从而实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: AppArmor stack restriction bypass allows unconfined processes to escape mandatory access controls, directly compromising host security.
items.reason_zh: AppArmor栈限制绕过漏洞允许无约束进程逃逸强制访问控制，直接危及主机安全。

items.reason_en: arm64 ptrace synchronization flaw permits tracer manipulation of syscall registers, enabling local privilege escalation on desktop systems.
items.reason_zh: arm64 ptrace同步缺陷允许跟踪器操纵系统调用寄存器，使桌面系统面临本地权限提升风险。

items.reason_en: AMDGPU compute queue handling error exposes graphics processing units to potential local exploitation and display subsystem corruption.
items.reason_zh: AMDGPU计算队列处理错误使图形处理器暴露于潜在的本地利用风险，并可能导致显示子系统损坏。

items.reason_en: HID driver probe race condition allows concurrent input reports during cleanup, risking local kernel memory corruption via malicious peripherals.
items.reason_zh: HID驱动探测竞态条件允许在清理过程中并发处理输入报告，通过恶意外设可能导致本地内核内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Patches an out-of-bounds write in NTFS3 attribute parsing, blocking local privilege escalation vectors triggered by maliciously crafted disk images.
items.reason_zh: 修补NTFS3属性解析中的越界写入漏洞，阻断由恶意构造磁盘镜像触发的本地权限提升攻击路径。

items.reason_en: Corrects an out-of-bounds read in the RTL8723BS Wi-Fi driver WMM parsing routine, reducing driver crashes and information leaks from rogue access points.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 RTL8723BS Wi-Fi 驱动中 WMM 解析例程的越界读取问题，降低了因恶意接入点导致的驱动崩溃和信息泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Fixes a USB TV device lifecycle race condition that triggers use-after-free errors during audio stream termination, improving desktop multimedia stability.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 USB TV 设备生命周期中的竞态条件，该条件会在音频流终止时触发释放后使用错误，从而提升了桌面多媒体的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Ensures proper TLB flushing after MES queue suspension in AMD GPUs, preventing race conditions that could lead to graphical corruption or local privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 确保在 AMD GPU 的 MES 队列挂起后正确执行 TLB 刷新，防止可能导致图形渲染异常或本地权限提升的竞态条件。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free race in perf mmap handling, protecting desktop workloads from crashes or exploitation when performance monitoring events are rapidly created and destroyed.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 perf mmap 处理中的释放后使用竞态条件，当性能监控事件被快速创建和销毁时，可保护桌面工作负载免受崩溃或利用攻击。

items.reason_en: Resolves a folio race condition in F2FS, improving filesystem stability and preventing potential data corruption or denial-of-service on modern Linux desktops.
items.reason_zh: 解决了 F2FS 中的 folio 竞态条件，提升了文件系统稳定性，并防止在现代 Linux 桌面上出现潜在的数据损坏或拒绝服务问题。

items.reason_en: AppArmor credential use-after-free triggered via VFS/socket hooks allows local attackers to bypass mandatory access controls and escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: 通过 VFS/socket 钩子触发的 AppArmor 凭据释放后使用漏洞，允许本地攻击者绕过强制访问控制并提升权限。

items.reason_en: Tracing ring buffer use-after-free during sub-buffer order changes can crash the kernel or enable arbitrary code execution when debug interfaces are active.
items.reason_zh: 在子缓冲区顺序变更期间，跟踪环形缓冲区的释放后使用漏洞可能导致内核崩溃或在调试接口激活时启用任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the HID sensor hub driver permits physical attackers using malicious sensors to corrupt kernel memory and execute code.
items.reason_zh: HID 传感器集线器驱动中的越界写入漏洞允许使用恶意传感器的物理攻击者破坏内核内存并执行代码。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free on USB gadget sound card teardown exposes the kernel to local exploitation when peripheral devices are unexpectedly disconnected.
items.reason_zh: USB gadget 声卡清理过程中的释放后使用漏洞会在外设意外断开连接时将内核暴露于本地利用风险之下。

items.reason_en: Missing report size validation in the Intel THC HID driver allows heap corruption from specially crafted input reports sent by malicious hardware.
items.reason_zh: Intel THC HID 驱动中缺少对报告大小的验证，允许恶意硬件发送特制输入报告导致堆损坏。

items.reason_en: Bounds GET_REPORT responses to the caller buffer, preventing a heap-based buffer overflow in Intel THC HID drivers that could compromise desktop input device integrity.
items.reason_zh: 将 GET_REPORT 响应限制在调用者缓冲区范围内，防止 Intel THC HID 驱动中出现可能破坏桌面输入设备完整性的基于堆的缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Fixes a race condition where the display connector callback is registered before platform driver initialization, mitigating potential use-after-free crashes in Linux framebuffer subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 修复了在平台驱动初始化之前注册显示连接器回调的竞态条件，缓解了 Linux 帧缓冲区子系统中潜在的释放后使用崩溃问题。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation via unverified plugin extraction in MobaXterm allows attackers to replace critical DLLs with malicious versions.
items.reason_zh: 通过 MobaXterm 中未经验证的插件提取实现本地权限提升，允许攻击者用恶意版本替换关键 DLL。

items.reason_en: Off-by-one buffer write in HP BIOS configuration parser enables potential memory corruption and privilege escalation during system configuration changes.
items.reason_zh: HP BIOS 配置解析器中的差一缓冲区写入漏洞可在系统配置更改期间导致潜在的内存损坏和权限提升。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Emacs TRAMP occurs when unsanitized filenames containing shell metacharacters are passed directly to local shells.
items.reason_zh: 当包含 Shell 元字符的未过滤文件名直接传递给本地 Shell 时，Emacs TRAMP 会发生命令注入漏洞。

items.reason_en: Flawed connection state tracking in Thunderbolt networking allows unauthorized link establishment after authentication failures, bypassing security controls.
items.reason_zh: Thunderbolt 网络中存在缺陷的连接状态跟踪机制允许在认证失败后建立未经授权的链路，从而绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: PingTools Network Utilities exposes an OS command injection vulnerability in its ICMP Watcher service, allowing local attackers to execute arbitrary system commands via crafted host values.
items.reason_zh: PingTools Network Utilities 的 ICMP Watcher 服务存在 OS 命令注入漏洞，允许本地攻击者通过特制的主机值执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Ath6kl WiFi driver performs unvalidated out-of-bounds reads from firmware-controlled fields, potentially exposing sensitive memory contents on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Ath6kl WiFi 驱动会对固件控制字段执行未经验证的越界读取，可能在移动设备上暴露敏感内存内容。

items.reason_en: Similar firmware IE length validation flaw in ath6kl allows out-of-bounds reads during connection events, compromising mobile network stack integrity.
items.reason_zh: ath6kl 中存在类似的固件 IE 长度验证缺陷，允许在连接事件期间发生越界读取，从而破坏移动网络栈的完整性。

items.reason_en: Mwifiex driver exposes unbounded association request IEs from firmware without buffer limits, creating a direct attack surface for mobile chipset exploitation.
items.reason_zh: Mwifiex 驱动从固件暴露无限制的关联请求 IE 且未设置缓冲区限制，为移动芯片组的利用创造了直接攻击面。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Bluetooth ISO frame processing affects mobile devices, allowing remote attackers to crash Bluetooth stacks or execute arbitrary code via malicious audio/data payloads.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙 ISO 帧处理中的释放后使用漏洞影响移动设备，允许远程攻击者通过恶意音频/数据载荷使蓝牙协议栈崩溃或执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Corrects Bluetooth SMP logic that improperly authenticated legacy session keys based on security level, closing a potential MITM attack vector.
items.reason_zh: 修正了蓝牙 SMP 逻辑中基于安全级别不正确验证旧版会话密钥的问题，封堵了潜在的中间人攻击途径。

items.reason_en: Resolves a type confusion vulnerability in the Bluetooth L2CAP layer during connection reconfiguration, preventing unexpected state manipulation or crashes.
items.reason_zh: 解决了蓝牙 L2CAP 层在连接重新配置期间的类型混淆漏洞，防止意外的状态操纵或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unbounded recursion in Fleetdm's Apple MDM enrollment plist parsing allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server via a small crafted payload, disrupting mobile device management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Fleetdm 的 Apple MDM 注册 plist 解析中存在无界递归漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过小型特制载荷使服务器崩溃，从而中断移动设备管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Bluetooth L2CAP race condition on connection termination enables local privilege escalation on mobile operating systems.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙 L2CAP 在连接终止时的竞态条件可导致移动操作系统上的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: SCO setup context lifetime bug in Bluetooth HCI leads to use-after-free vulnerabilities exploitable via paired audio peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙 HCI 中 SCO 设置上下文的生命周期缺陷会导致释放后使用漏洞，可通过已配对的音频外设进行利用。

items.reason_en: Missing socket lock in NFC LLCP stack creates race conditions that could be triggered by malicious near-field interaction tags.
items.reason_zh: NFC LLCP 协议栈中缺少套接字锁会引发竞态条件，可能被恶意近场交互标签触发。

items.reason_en: Removes flawed VM-wide VNCR mapping counters in KVM arm64, fixing race conditions that could allow guest VMs to bypass memory isolation on Android/Linux mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: 移除了 KVM arm64 中缺陷的虚拟机级 VNCR 映射计数器，修复了可能导致客户机虚拟机在 Android/Linux 移动设备上绕过内存隔离的竞态条件。

items.reason_en: Corrects missing sign-extension for VA ranges in KVM arm64 TLBI operations, preventing address translation errors that could compromise mobile hypervisor security.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 KVM arm64 TLBI 操作中 VA 范围缺失的符号扩展问题，防止可能破坏移动虚拟化程序安全性的地址转换错误。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free in IIO anonymous buffer release, mitigating stability and exploitation risks for mobile sensor frameworks accessing hardware data.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 IIO 匿名缓冲区释放中的释放后使用漏洞，降低了移动传感器框架访问硬件数据时的稳定性和利用风险。

items.reason_en: Resolves a use-after-free vulnerability in the MT7925 WiFi driver during probe errors, which could allow local privilege escalation on mobile and tablet Linux devices.
items.reason_zh: 修复了MT7925 WiFi驱动程序在探测错误时存在的释放后使用漏洞，该漏洞可能导致移动和平板Linux设备上的本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Clamps association request/response lengths before subtracting IE offsets, preventing integer underflows that could corrupt packet processing in MediaTek mobile Wi-Fi chips.
items.reason_zh: 在减去IE（信息元素）偏移量前对关联请求/响应长度进行限制，防止整数下溢导致MediaTek移动Wi-Fi芯片的数据包处理逻辑受损。

items.reason_en: Guest-controlled vSID exceeding hardware limits in Tegra IOMMU driver risks memory corruption and potential VM escape on mobile SoCs.
items.reason_zh: Tegra IOMMU驱动程序中由客户机控制的vSID超出硬件限制，可能导致内存损坏及移动SoC上的虚拟机逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Improper probe state unwinding on Qualcomm IOMMU registration failure can trigger use-after-free conditions during device initialization.
items.reason_zh: 在Qualcomm IOMMU注册失败时未正确回退探测状态，可能在设备初始化期间触发释放后使用条件。

items.reason_en: Unbounded EC-reported port count in ChromeOS USB-PD driver leads to fixed-size array overflow during power supply initialization.
items.reason_zh: ChromeOS USB-PD驱动程序中EC报告的端口数量未设上限，导致电源初始化期间发生固定大小数组溢出。

items.reason_en: TP-Link Tapo cameras contain a heap-based buffer overflow in their HTTP POST body parser due to missing boundary validation, enabling remote memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: TP-Link Tapo摄像头的HTTP POST主体解析器存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，原因是缺少边界验证，可导致远程内存损坏。

items.reason_en: FireWire networking module mishandles fragmented datagram reassembly, enabling potential memory corruption in IoT edge devices utilizing legacy bus interfaces.
items.reason_zh: FireWire网络模块未能正确处理分片数据报重组，可能导致使用传统总线接口的IoT边缘设备发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Mac802154 security layer accepts frames shorter than required authentication tags, effectively bypassing cryptographic verification in 6LoWPAN and IoT mesh networks.
items.reason_zh: Mac802154安全层接受了短于所需认证标签的帧，从而在6LoWPAN和IoT网状网络中有效绕过了密码学验证。

items.reason_en: QRTR subsystem allows socket creation outside the initial network namespace due to global state partitioning flaws, breaking containerization isolation in IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: 由于全局状态分区存在缺陷，QRTR子系统允许在网络命名空间之外创建套接字，破坏了IoT网关的容器化隔离性。

items.reason_en: Patches a stack buffer overflow in Zephyr's OSDP Control Panel reply parser, critical for securing IoT peripheral management systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复了Zephyr的OSDP控制面板回复解析器中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，对保障IoT外设管理系统的安全至关重要。

items.reason_en: Resolves multiple out-of-bounds reads in rtl8723bs IE parsing loops, hardening widely deployed low-cost IoT Wi-Fi chipsets against rogue AP attacks.
items.reason_zh: 修复了rtl8723bs中IE解析循环里的多个越界读取问题，增强了广泛部署的低成本IoT Wi-Fi芯片组抵御恶意AP攻击的能力。

items.reason_en: Fixes WEP length underflow and OOB reads in rtl8723bs authentication, preventing credential theft or connection hijacking on embedded networks.
items.reason_zh: 修复了rtl8723bs身份验证过程中的WEP长度下溢和越界读取问题，防止嵌入式网络中的凭证窃取或连接劫持。

items.reason_en: Corrects write buffer corruption in digi_acceleport USB serial driver, safeguarding industrial IoT gateways from data integrity violations.
items.reason_zh: 修正了digi_acceleport USB串口驱动程序中的写缓冲区损坏问题，保护工业IoT网关免受数据完整性违规的影响。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of SFP module EEPROM replies in ethtool CMIS allows malicious hardware to trigger out-of-bounds writes in network interface controllers commonly found in IoT gateways.
items.reason_zh: ethtool CMIS中对SFP模块EEPROM回复的验证不足，使得恶意硬件能够触发常见于IoT网关的网络接口控制器中的越界写入。

items.reason_en: Concurrency flaw in the Bluetooth BNEP stack leads to use-after-free reads, threatening stability and security of embedded systems relying on Bluetooth networking profiles.
items.reason_zh: 蓝牙BNEP协议栈中的并发缺陷会导致释放后使用读取操作，威胁依赖蓝牙网络配置文件的嵌入式系统的稳定性和安全性。

items.reason_en: Fixes a use-after-free error in Bluetooth HCI connection stream synchronization after lock release. Mitigates remote exploitation risks via malformed Bluetooth LE control frames in connected smart devices and gateways.
items.reason_zh: 修复了蓝牙HCI连接流同步在锁释放后出现的释放后使用错误。降低了通过畸形蓝牙LE控制帧在已连接智能设备和网关中进行远程利用的风险。

items.reason_en: Adds necessary scatterlist copy operations before in-place cryptographic transformations in 6LoWPAN stacks. Prevents memory corruption in constrained IoT network interfaces performing link-layer security.
items.reason_zh: 在6LoWPAN协议栈进行原位密码学转换前添加了必要的分散列表复制操作。防止在执行链路层安全的受限IoT网络接口中发生内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Limits injected antenna indices during radiotap header parsing to prevent out-of-bounds bit shifts. Reduces attack surface for wireless fuzzing and local privilege escalation on IoT edge routers.
items.reason_zh: 在解析radiotap头时限制注入的天线索引，以防止越界位移操作。减少了IoT边缘路由器遭受无线模糊测试和本地权限提升的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Validates Thunderbolt XDomain request packet sizes before type casting, preventing malicious dock/device exploitation targeting IoT and edge hardware.
items.reason_zh: 在进行类型转换前验证Thunderbolt XDomain请求数据包的大小，防止针对IoT和边缘硬件的恶意扩展坞/设备利用。

items.reason_en: Adds skb length validation to Bluetooth RFCOMM MCC handlers, blocking truncated frame attacks that could compromise paired IoT peripherals.
items.reason_zh: 向蓝牙RFCOMM MCC处理程序添加了skb长度验证，阻止可能危及已配对IoT外设的截断帧攻击。

items.reason_en: Fixes a bulk-out buffer overflow in the KL5KUSB105 USB serial driver, securing IoT modems and serial-to-USB converters from memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 修复了KL5KUSB105 USB串口驱动程序中的批量输出缓冲区溢出漏洞，保护IoT调制解调器和串口转USB转换器免受内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Adds validation for firmware-provided interface indices in the BRCMFMAC WiFi driver, stopping out-of-bounds array accesses triggered by malformed events.
items.reason_zh: 在BRCMFMAC WiFi驱动程序中增加了对固件提供的接口索引的验证，阻止由畸形事件触发的越界数组访问。

items.reason_en: Enforces strict validation of packet counts in USBIP RET_SUBMIT responses, preventing memory corruption from spoofed network packets targeting IoT edge devices.
items.reason_zh: 对USBIP RET_SUBMIT响应中的数据包计数实施严格验证，防止针对IoT边缘设备的伪造网络包导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Default connection port exposure in the embedded GeoVision web server allows unauthenticated remote attackers to establish unauthorized connections, potentially leading to device compromise or surveillance data leakage.
items.reason_zh: 嵌入式GeoVision Web服务器默认暴露连接端口，允许未经认证的远程攻击者建立未授权连接，可能导致设备被控或监控数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Authenticated stack-based buffer overflow in the Wi-Fi onboarding configuration path enables remote command execution on smart home surveillance cameras.
items.reason_zh: Wi-Fi入网配置路径中存在经过身份验证的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在智能家居监控摄像头上实现远程命令执行。

items.reason_en: Improper shell escaping in ZoneMinder's downloadEvents function enables remote code execution for authenticated users, directly compromising surveillance infrastructure and camera networks.
items.reason_zh: ZoneMinder的downloadEvents函数中存在不当的Shell转义问题，使已认证用户能够实现远程代码执行，直接危及监控基础设施和摄像头网络。

items.reason_en: DNS resolver flaw in Amazon FreeRTOS allows remote attackers to poison device DNS caches via forged replies, disrupting IoT network connectivity.
items.reason_zh: Amazon FreeRTOS中的DNS解析器缺陷允许远程攻击者通过伪造回复污染设备DNS缓存，从而破坏IoT网络连接。

items.reason_en: IPv6 Router Advertisement handler weakness enables attackers to hijack device network configuration, potentially redirecting traffic or causing denial of service.
items.reason_zh: IPv6路由器通告处理程序的弱点使攻击者能够劫持设备网络配置，可能导致流量重定向或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded root password in EVbee DC-80 firmware exposes the SSH daemon to the network, enabling immediate unauthorized administrative access to IoT hardware.
items.reason_zh: EVbee DC-80固件中硬编码的root密码将SSH守护进程暴露于网络中，使攻击者能够立即获得对IoT硬件的未授权管理访问权限。

items.reason_en: Renesas PHY driver double reference release causes resource corruption in embedded SoCs, destabilizing IoT hardware initialization.
items.reason_zh: Renesas PHY驱动程序的重复引用释放导致嵌入式SoC资源损坏，致使IoT硬件初始化不稳定。

items.reason_en: Unflushed cached MSI writes in PCI endpoint controllers can corrupt interrupt routing, severely affecting embedded industrial hardware reliability.
items.reason_zh: PCI端点控制器中未刷新的缓存MSI写入可能破坏中断路由，严重影响嵌入式工业硬件的可靠性。

items.reason_en: DRM OMAP display driver copies ISR tables to stack, risking stack exhaustion and crashes in embedded display subsystems.
items.reason_zh: DRM OMAP显示驱动程序将ISR表复制到栈上，可能导致嵌入式显示子系统栈耗尽和崩溃。

items.reason_en: Validates RPMI notification lengths in RISC-V mailboxes, preventing arbitrary memory access and firmware manipulation in embedded SoC architectures.
items.reason_zh: 验证RISC-V邮箱中的RPMI通知长度，防止在嵌入式SoC架构中出现任意内存访问和固件篡改。

items.reason_en: Bounds UCSI DisplayPort altmode indexing to stop out-of-bounds access attempts in USB-C connected peripherals and smart displays.
items.reason_zh: 限制UCSI DisplayPort替代模式索引，阻止USB-C连接外设和智能显示器中的越界访问尝试。

items.reason_en: Resolves a concurrency race in NFC NCI data exchange, protecting mobile and IoT contactless communication stacks from transaction corruption.
items.reason_zh: 解决NFC NCI数据交换中的并发竞争条件，保护移动设备和物联网非接触式通信协议栈免受事务损坏。

items.reason_en: Adds sanity checks for malformed messages in Extron HDMI drivers, preventing buffer overflows that could crash IoT multimedia gateways or embedded Linux systems.
items.reason_zh: 为Extron HDMI驱动程序添加畸形消息的合理性检查，防止可能导致物联网多媒体网关或嵌入式Linux系统崩溃的缓冲区溢出。

items.reason_en: Resolves a use-after-free during endpoint parsing in OV02A10 camera drivers, securing IoT vision modules against firmware-induced kernel panics or memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 解决OV02A10摄像头驱动程序在端点解析期间的释放后使用漏洞，保护物联网视觉模块免受固件引发的内核崩溃或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Fixes improper teardown ordering in OV7740 drivers, preventing mutex destruction before control handler cleanup which could destabilize IoT camera subsystems.
items.reason_zh: 修复OV7740驱动程序中不正确的销毁顺序，防止在控制处理程序清理前销毁互斥锁，从而避免导致物联网相机子系统不稳定。

items.reason_en: Fixes a premature of_node_put leaving a dangling pointer in the AS3722 regulator driver, preventing kernel oopses in embedded IoT power management systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复AS3722稳压器驱动程序中过早调用of_node_put导致的悬垂指针问题，防止嵌入式物联网电源管理系统出现内核Oops。

items.reason_en: Adds missing DMA mask setup for the OMAP SSI controller, ensuring reliable data transfer and preventing memory corruption in industrial IoT serial interfaces.
items.reason_zh: 为OMAP SSI控制器补充缺失的DMA掩码设置，确保数据传输可靠并防止工业物联网串行接口中的内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in QcalAgent permits authenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive system files beyond intended directories.
items.reason_zh: QcalAgent存在路径遍历漏洞，允许已认证攻击者向预期目录外窃取敏感系统文件。

items.reason_en: Publishing a stack-allocated reply buffer to the receive path causes use-after-free upon command timeouts in QNAP MCU drivers.
items.reason_zh: 将栈分配的响应缓冲区发布到接收路径，会在QNAP MCU驱动程序命令超时时引发释放后使用漏洞。
