items.reason_en: Fixes a pre-authentication out-of-bounds heap read in NVMe/TCP Discovery Get Log Page, blocking unauthorized storage target reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 NVMe/TCP 发现获取日志页中的预认证越界堆读取漏洞，阻止未授权的存储目标探测。

items.reason_en: Enforces payload bounds checking in NVMe/TCP authentication replies, mitigating hash/DH value manipulation attacks on storage arrays.
items.reason_zh: 在 NVMe/TCP 身份验证响应中强制执行载荷边界检查，缓解针对存储阵列的哈希/DH 值篡改攻击。

items.reason_en: Corrects carry overflow logic in Linux ECC cryptography routines, ensuring mathematical correctness for secure key generation and TLS implementations.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 Linux ECC 加密例程中的进位溢出逻辑，确保密钥生成和 TLS 实现的数学正确性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the network handshake subsystem drops required locks before socket dereferencing, creating use-after-free windows exploitable for privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 网络握手子系统存在竞态条件，在套接字解引用前错误释放了所需锁，形成可被利用进行提权的释放后使用（UAF）窗口。

items.reason_en: Reversed arguments in list_splice_init during network namespace teardown leak pending requests, causing resource exhaustion and use-after-free conditions.
items.reason_zh: 网络命名空间清理期间 list_splice_init 参数顺序颠倒导致待处理请求泄漏，引发资源耗尽和释放后使用问题。

items.reason_en: NFSv4 permission mask oversight fails to enforce write checks for O_TRUNC operations, allowing unauthorized file truncation and potential data loss.
items.reason_zh: NFSv4 权限掩码处理疏漏未能对 O_TRUNC 操作执行写入检查，允许未授权的文件截断并可能导致数据丢失。

items.reason_en: Corrects tail fragment offset handling in BPF sockmap data insertion, preventing memory corruption in eBPF-based network acceleration. Vital for container orchestration platforms relying on high-performance packet processing.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 BPF sockmap 数据插入中的尾部片段偏移处理，防止基于 eBPF 的网络加速出现内存损坏。这对依赖高性能数据包处理的容器编排平台至关重要。

items.reason_en: Fixes a concurrent use-after-free race in block cgroup statistics flushing during parallel disk I/O. Prevents kernel panics and memory corruption in multi-tenant storage and virtualization hosts.
items.reason_zh: 修复了并行磁盘 I/O 期间块 cgroup 统计刷新时的并发释放后使用竞态条件，防止多租户存储与虚拟化主机发生内核崩溃和内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Resolves an integer overflow in keyctl public key parameter handling that could corrupt internal buffers. Mitigates local privilege escalation risks tied to system cryptographic key management utilities.
items.reason_zh: 解决了 keyctl 公钥参数处理中的整数溢出问题，该问题可能损坏内部缓冲区。缓解了与系统加密密钥管理工具相关的本地提权风险。

items.reason_en: Fixes a memory lifecycle race in the BPF task_vma iterator, preventing use-after-free vulnerabilities in eBPF-based monitoring and security tools.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 BPF task_vma 迭代器中的内存生命周期竞态条件，防止基于 eBPF 的监控与安全工具出现释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Corrects the BPF verifier's failure path analysis for absolute/indirect loads in subprograms, ensuring sandbox enforcement remains intact.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 BPF 验证器对子程序中绝对/间接加载操作的失败路径分析，确保沙箱策略得以完整执行。

items.reason_en: Removes the strict CLONE_THREAD requirement for private futex hash allocation, fixing scheduling bypasses that could undermine process isolation.
items.reason_zh: 移除了私有 futex 哈希分配中对 CLONE_THREAD 的严格限制，修复了可能破坏进程隔离的调度绕过问题。

items.reason_en: Introduces bounds checking for node_id in BPF arena page allocation, preventing out-of-bounds memory access during eBPF program compilation.
items.reason_zh: 在 BPF arena 页面分配中为 node_id 引入边界检查，防止 eBPF 程序编译期间的越界内存访问。

items.reason_en: Invalid DACL offset validation in the SMB client permits out-of-bounds memory access when connecting to malicious or corrupted servers.
items.reason_zh: SMB 客户端的 DACL 偏移验证缺陷允许在连接恶意或损坏服务器时发生越界内存访问。

items.reason_en: Missing page map validation in biovec_phys_mergeable bypasses DMA safety checks, risking kernel memory corruption during block layer operations.
items.reason_zh: biovec_phys_mergeable 中缺失页面映射验证绕过了 DMA 安全检查，在块层操作期间可能导致内核内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Slab use-after-free in xfrm state deletion during IPsec teardown can be triggered remotely to crash network stacks or escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: IPsec 清理过程中 xfrm 状态删除时的 Slab 释放后使用漏洞可被远程触发，导致网络栈崩溃或提权。

items.reason_en: Addresses an out-of-bounds write in AMDGPU KFD event page handling, blocking unprivileged userspace processes from triggering kernel memory corruption and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 AMDGPU KFD 事件页处理中的越界写入问题，阻止无特权用户态进程触发内核内存损坏与提权。

items.reason_en: Enforces mandatory MITM requirements for Bluetooth SMP pairing responses, strengthening link-layer security against man-in-the-middle attacks during device authentication and pairing.
items.reason_zh: 对蓝牙 SMP 配对响应强制执行中间人攻击（MITM）防范要求，增强设备认证与配对过程中的链路层安全。

items.reason_en: Corrects an integer wraparound issue in ext4 indirect block allocation, preventing potential filesystem corruption or denial of service.
items.reason_zh: 修正了 ext4 间接块分配中的整数回绕问题，防止潜在的文件系统损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Fixes a symlink flushing order flaw in BusyBox dpkg-deb extraction, mitigating path traversal risks during package installation.
items.reason_zh: 修复了 BusyBox dpkg-deb 解压过程中的符号链接刷新顺序缺陷，降低包安装期间的路径遍历风险。

items.reason_en: Patches a privilege escalation vector in Nix package manager where repair operations could replace store paths before content verification.
items.reason_zh: 修补了 Nix 包管理器中的提权漏洞，该漏洞允许在内容验证前通过修复操作替换存储路径。

items.reason_en: Prevents denial-of-service via infinite loops during logical-to-physical block mapping in ext4 directory operations, ensuring filesystem stability when extent tree insertion fails due to corrupted inputs.
items.reason_zh: 防止 ext4 目录操作中因损坏输入导致 extents 树插入失败时，逻辑到物理块映射陷入无限循环而引发拒绝服务，确保文件系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Fixes a race condition where concurrent readers observe uninitialized journal inode pointers, preventing kernel oops and ensuring safe filesystem initialization under multi-threaded workloads.
items.reason_zh: 修复了并发读取者观察到未初始化日志 inode 指针的竞态条件，防止内核 Oops，并确保多线程负载下文件系统初始化的安全性。

items.reason_en: Race condition between futex key optimization and VMA policy replacement leads to use-after-free threats, compromising system stability under concurrent memory binding operations.
items.reason_zh: futex 键优化与 VMA 策略替换之间的竞态条件会导致释放后使用威胁，影响并发内存绑定操作下的系统稳定性。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in the inference model handler allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by manipulating target class arguments in ML workflows.
items.reason_zh: 推理模型处理器中存在不安全的反序列化漏洞，攻击者可通过操纵机器学习工作流中的目标类参数来执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Failure to bind early attestation evidence to the TLS connection enables evidence relaying attacks, undermining hardware trust chain verification.
items.reason_zh: 未将早期证明证据绑定至 TLS 连接，导致证明中继攻击，破坏了硬件信任链验证机制。

items.reason_en: Expert-distribution recording endpoint flaw in SGLang triggers denial of service when manipulated, impacting the availability and reliability of large language model inference services.
items.reason_zh: SGLang 的专家分布记录端点存在缺陷，遭操纵时将触发拒绝服务，影响大语言模型推理服务的可用性与可靠性。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in fastllm's Safetensors weight loading component enables remote code execution when processing malicious AI model files.
items.reason_zh: fastllm 的 Safetensors 权重加载组件存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，处理恶意 AI 模型文件时可导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Missing bounds validation in libaom's AV1 encoder allows crafted video frames to trigger remote code execution in media processing applications.
items.reason_zh: libaom 的 AV1 编码器缺少边界验证，允许构造的视频帧在媒体处理应用中触发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Flatpak-builder fails to disable Git hooks during patch application, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary host commands during builds.
items.reason_zh: Flatpak-builder 在应用补丁时未能禁用 Git hooks，允许攻击者在构建过程中执行任意主机命令。

items.reason_en: NVMe unsolicited context unlinking flaw in qla2xxx causes use-after-free during error handling, risking kernel panics or privilege escalation in enterprise storage stacks.
items.reason_zh: qla2xxx 驱动中 NVMe 未请求上下文解链缺陷在错误处理时会导致释放后使用漏洞，在企业存储栈中可能引发内核崩溃或权限提升。

items.reason_en: BPF verifier bypass allows untrusted pointer writes, undermining the security guarantees of eBPF-based observability, tracing, and networking tools.
items.reason_zh: BPF 验证器绕过漏洞允许写入不可信指针，削弱了基于 eBPF 的可观测性、跟踪及网络工具的安全保障。

items.reason_en: Race condition in bpf_find_vma() leads to use-after-free on mm_struct, threatening the stability and memory isolation of concurrent BPF programs.
items.reason_zh: bpf_find_vma() 函数中的竞态条件会导致 mm_struct 释放后使用漏洞，危及并发 BPF 程序的稳定性与内存隔离。

items.reason_en: HID core quiesce flaw causes use-after-free during device removal, allowing local privilege escalation via malicious USB or input device interactions.
items.reason_zh: HID 核心静默处理缺陷在设备卸载期间会导致释放后使用漏洞，攻击者可通过恶意 USB 或输入设备交互实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Double-free vulnerability in the IPsec xfrm framework allows arbitrary kernel memory corruption across all Linux deployments.
items.reason_zh: IPsec xfrm 框架存在双重释放漏洞，可导致所有 Linux 部署环境中的任意内核内存破坏。

items.reason_en: Missing validation in the ublk userspace block layer permits out-of-bounds memory access when importing user buffers.
items.reason_zh: ublk 用户空间块层缺乏有效性验证，在导入用户缓冲区时可触发越界内存访问。

items.reason_en: Flawed lifetime management in kernel module duplication code triggers use-after-free conditions during dynamic module loading.
items.reason_zh: 内核模块复制代码中的生命周期管理缺陷会在动态加载模块时触发释放后使用漏洞。

items.reason_en: Fixes improper completion queue freeing in SMBDirect, preventing kernel panics and privilege escalation on RDMA-enabled enterprise systems.
items.reason_zh: 修复 SMBDirect 中完成队列释放不当的问题，防止启用 RDMA 的企业系统发生内核崩溃及权限提升。

items.reason_en: Eliminates a use-after-free race during NFSD client state revocation, hardening server-side NFS exports against concurrent connection teardowns.
items.reason_zh: 消除 NFSD 客户端状态吊销期间的释放后使用竞态条件，增强服务器端 NFS 共享在面对并发连接断开时的安全性。

items.reason_en: Adds missing mutex protection in Ceph MDS access checks, preventing race-induced metadata corruption in distributed metadata servers.
items.reason_zh: 为 Ceph MDS 访问检查补充缺失的互斥锁保护，防止分布式元数据服务器因竞态条件导致元数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Corrects a use-after-free in BPF trampoline updates, preserving the integrity and security guarantees of eBPF sandboxing mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 修正 BPF 跳板更新过程中的释放后使用漏洞，保障 eBPF 沙箱机制的完整性与安全保证。

items.reason_en: Synchronizes authentication timeout cancellation during NVMe/TCP teardown, blocking race-condition exploits that could bypass storage target security.
items.reason_zh: 同步 NVMe/TCP 连接拆除期间的认证超时取消操作，阻断可能绕过存储目标安全性的竞态条件利用。

items.reason_en: Holds qpair locks during NVMe LS reject submission in qla2xxx, preventing race conditions that could corrupt request rings and cause storage controller failures.
items.reason_zh: 在 qla2xxx 提交 NVMe LS 拒绝请求期间持有 qpair 锁，防止竞态条件破坏请求环并引发存储控制器故障。

items.reason_en: Avoids double completion bugs in async IOCB timeouts for qla2xxx, safeguarding enterprise SAN/NVMe arrays from hangs or data corruption during timeout recovery.
items.reason_zh: 修复 qla2xxx 异步 IOCB 超时处理中的双重完成缺陷，防止企业级 SAN/NVMe 阵列在超时恢复过程中出现死锁或数据损坏。

items.reason_en: Fixes an IRQ leak on cpuhp_setup_state failure in NXP PIT clocksource, preventing resource exhaustion and timer drift in edge computing deployments.
items.reason_zh: 修复 NXP PIT 时钟源在 cpuhp_setup_state 失败时引发的 IRQ 泄漏问题，防止边缘计算部署中出现资源耗尽与时钟漂移。

items.reason_en: Resolves a subbuf resize race in the Linux ring buffer, ensuring reliable tracing and debugging capabilities without kernel instability or data loss.
items.reason_zh: 解决 Linux 环形缓冲区中子缓冲区扩容的竞态条件，确保跟踪与调试功能的可靠性，避免内核不稳定或数据丢失。

items.reason_en: Fixes a stack buffer overflow in ACPI PFR capability queries, preventing firmware-induced kernel crashes across diverse server and workstation platforms.
items.reason_zh: 修复 ACPI PFR 能力查询中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，防止因固件交互导致各类服务器与工作站的内核崩溃。

items.reason_en: Hardens BPF bloom filter sizing and indexing on 32-bit kernels, mitigating arithmetic truncation bugs that could destabilize eBPF-based security monitoring tools.
items.reason_zh: 加固 32 位内核下 BPF 布隆过滤器的大小计算与索引逻辑，缓解算术截断漏洞对基于 eBPF 的安全监控工具的稳定性影响。

items.reason_en: Stripping GSO state from fragments before reassembly bypasses network stack optimizations and security validations.
items.reason_zh: 在数据包重组前剥离分片的 GSO 状态会绕过网络栈的性能优化与安全校验机制。

items.reason_en: Hardware analytics errors force software fallback that writes to still-mapped DMA buffers, causing memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: 硬件分析错误迫使系统回退至软件处理模式，向仍处于映射状态的 DMA 缓冲区写入数据，从而引发内存破坏。

items.reason_en: Accessing non-current task credentials without proper locking in SMACK breaks mandatory access control integrity.
items.reason_zh: SMACK 在未加锁的情况下访问非当前任务的凭证信息，破坏了强制访问控制的完整性。
